notes.text:
An update is available for util-linux.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The util-linux packages contain a large variety of low-level system utilities that are necessary for a Linux system to function. Among others, these include the fdisk configuration tool and the login program.

Security Fix(es):

* util-linux: TOCTOU in the mount program when setting up loop devices (CVE-2026-27456)

* util-linux: util-linux: heap use-after-free in libblkid nested partition probing (CVE-2026-13595)

* util-linux: TOCTOU in the mount program via ancestor directory swap on target path (CVE-2026-53613)

* util-linux: util-linux: TOCTOU in the mount program when applying post-mount ownership/mode changes (CVE-2026-53612)

* util-linux: util-linux: SUID mount(8) allows nosuid/noexec bypass via LIBMOUNT_FORCE_MOUNT2 (CVE-2026-53614)

* util-linux: util-linux: failed external mount helper still runs privileged X-mount post-hooks (CVE-2026-76642)

* util-linux: util-linux: nsenter --join-cgroup leaks root cgroup migration authority (CVE-2026-78408)

* util-linux: util-linux: restricted bind mounts do not pin the source, allowing X-mount.owner/group/mode redirection (CVE-2026-78410)

* util-linux: util-linux: Partition metadata compromise via integer overflow in DOS partition parser (CVE-2026-53615)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
